identity: A timed task widget with controls and changing content that the user must watch or act on at the right moment.

scenarios.name: chase
scenarios.screen: A circle is on a board, ready to move. The pointer has not yet tracked it, and the time-inside count is at zero.
never: A square or triangle to chase

arrangements.text: The circle sits inside a wide board, with the time-inside readout beside the board.
The circle sits inside an upright board, with the time-inside readout below it.

scenarios.hint: Show one moving circle, pointer outside, elapsed time near start and dwell counter below threshold.

scenarios.name: moving
scenarios.screen: A board has four lanes where shapes move toward an edge. A cue names the target color; the task has about nine shapes in its schedule, and none have been caught.
never: A color picker for changing the target

arrangements.text: Four horizontal lanes run across a wide board, with the target-color cue above them.
Four columns run down an upright board, with the target-color cue above them.
Four horizontal lanes run across a wide board, with every scheduled shape already positioned within a lane.

scenarios.hint: Show several requested-color shapes and a few differently colored distractors on a motion board. No shapes already caught; depict one instant, not motion trails.

scenarios.name: delay
scenarios.screen: A short task card shows its action controls. In button tasks, the requested button is inactive or represented by a placeholder at the start; in the two-button timing task, ONE and TWO are visible during a get-ready phase.
never: A timer showing that the wait between ONE and TWO has finished

arrangements.text: The card title and text sit above the action controls, with the status below them.
The card text sits to the left of the action controls, with the status beneath the text.

scenarios.hint: Show the requested Start or Next button disabled with a clear Waiting status. Notes must say it becomes enabled on the task clock; not permanently disabled.

scenarios.name: simon
scenarios.screen: A group of colored pads is visible while the pattern plays. No repeat presses have been entered.
never: The entire pattern lit at once
A completed set of repeat presses

arrangements.text: The pads form a compact group, with the playback status above them.
The pads form a row, with the playback status beside the row.

scenarios.hint: Show four distinct colored pads, one currently illuminated and a Watch status; a later input phase allows replay. No extra unrelated blinking elements.

scenarios.name: stock
scenarios.screen: A stock symbol and its current quote appear with a Buy control. No shares have been bought.

arrangements.text: The stock name and quote sit above the Buy control.
The quote sits beside the stock name, with the Buy control directly below it.

scenarios.name: popup
scenarios.screen: A sign-in form has empty username and password fields and a Log in button. The interruption has not opened, so the form is available.

arrangements.text: The username field sits above the password field, with Log in below both.
The username and password fields sit side by side, with Log in beneath them.

scenarios.hint: Show empty login username/password fields and a distracting but dismissible popup.

scenarios.name: loading
scenarios.screen: A search field contains the query and has a Search button. The search has not run, so no loaded results or result page is open.

arrangements.text: The prefilled search field sits beside Search, with the results area below.
Search sits below the prefilled field, with the results area beneath the button.

scenarios.name: toast
scenarios.screen: A Send code control and an on-screen number keypad are visible. The code entry is empty, and no code toast is showing.
never: A code sent to a second destination

arrangements.text: Send code sits above the empty entry, and the keypad sits below it.
The empty entry and Send code sit beside the keypad, with Verify below the entry.

scenarios.name: countdown
scenarios.screen: A hold timer is running above two or three groups of option chips and a booking control. No options are selected and no reservation is confirmed.
never: An expired hold at the start
A cancellation link for a completed reservation

arrangements.text: The hold timer sits above stacked option groups, with the booking control below them.
The hold timer sits beside option groups arranged in columns, with the booking control beneath the columns.

scenarios.name: carousel
scenarios.screen: One promotion slide is visible with its title, subtitle and link. Dots and previous and next arrows control the slideshow; no promotion page is open.
never: Two slides open as pages at once
A slide selector with more dots than slides

arrangements.text: The visible slide sits between the arrows, with the dots below it.
The dots sit beside the visible slide, while the arrows sit at its opposite ends.

scenarios.name: debounce
scenarios.screen: An empty city field is visible. It has no selected city, and no suggestions or Searching… message is showing.

arrangements.text: The field label sits above the city field, with space for suggestions directly below.
The field label sits beside the city field, with space for suggestions beneath the field.

scenarios.name: refresh
scenarios.screen: A list is in its first load, with a spinner and skeleton rows. No named item has been opened.
never: A contact or ticket page already open
An idle, fully loaded first list

arrangements.text: The list heading sits above the spinner and skeleton rows.
The list heading sits beside the list, with the spinner above the skeleton rows.

scenarios.name: deadline
scenarios.screen: A task card identifies the offer or delivery-slot task before its action window opens. The timed claim button or slot choices are not yet available.
never: A life bar showing time left in an already open window

arrangements.text: The task title and text sit above the area where the timed controls appear.
The task title and text sit beside the area where the timed controls appear.

scenarios.name: search
scenarios.screen: An empty product search field sits above a list of popular results. The target has not been searched for, and no product page is open.
never: The target product in the initial popular list
A settled list for a query that has not been entered

arrangements.text: The search field sits above the popular-results list.
The search field sits beside the popular-results list, with result rows stacked beneath the list heading.
